Snapshot of the day
 In your role as Industrial Cybersecurity Expert for Critical Infrastructure, you will become a true professional in thinking outside the box. To better protect our IT and OT systems, you will explore all possible ways to deceive, bypass, and strengthen them effectively. You will ask questions that have no answers yet and look for gaps where hardly anyone suspects them. Your work will directly contribute to improving our project execution and meeting market requirements. You will work closely with various teams to implement new security features and optimize existing systems. Embedded in a team of cybersecurity experts you have the chance to see cybersecurity from different angles and continuously exchange with and learn from colleagues around the world. Your contribution will help to improve the resilience of critical infrastructure to face the challenges of today’s world.
 How You’ll Make An Impact
Analyzing cybersecurity requirements derived from applicable regulations, industry standards, and customer specifications, translating them into actionable measures and ensuring their fulfillment through comprehensive traceability.
Supporting the definition, alignment and implementation of a holistic cybersecurity requirements engineering framework.
Providing guidance and training to various departments to support the effective implementation of cybersecurity requirements engineering.
Leading cybersecurity process implementation initiatives and foster organizational awareness through training and knowledge sharing.
Supporting regulatory and standards compliance by implementing cybersecurity requirements in line with IEC 62443, NERC CIP, EU Data Act, CRA, and other relevant frameworks.
 What You Bring
University degree in IT Security, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Electronics, Electrical Engineering with focus on IT Security or a comparable qualification with extensive professional experience in OT or product security.
Basic security certifications such as GIAC GSEC or similar.
Knowledge of relevant cybersecurity standards and regulations (e.g., ISA/IEC 62443, CRA, NERC CIP, BDEW Whitepaper, ISO27001 is a plus).
Knowledge of digital certificates (X.509) and system hardening techniques.
Experience with firewalls, certificates, intrusion detection systems, TLS/SSL, 802.1X.
Basic skills in testing tools like Kali Linux, Nessus, Wireshark. 
Capability of multitasking, with excellent organizational skills while assuring a high-quality work process
Intercultural sensitivity, to work in (virtual) international team
Strong interpersonal and teamwork skills, ability to analyze and learn as well as motivation, result orientation and enthusiasm to make a positive contribution to the team.
Fully conversant with Microsoft – Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, Visio
Business-level ﬂuency in English. German skills will be beneficial.

 About The Team
 Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. Siemens Energy offers an outstanding range and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and technology related to digital grid technology.
 Who is Siemens Energy?
 At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. We meet the growing energy demand across 90+ countries while ensuring our climate is protected. With 100,000 dedicated employees, we not only generate electricity for over 16% of the global community, but we’re also using our technology to help protect people and the environment.
Our cross-border team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.
